why_standalone_candidate_fails: A GCC-2.96-compiled C function necessarily emits its own prologue, its own register/parameter setup, and its own stack allocation at the address that source is anchored to. The reference bytes at 0800ee14 have none of that: execution arrives with r7/r8/r9/r10/r11 and the sp frame already live from FunctionHead_0800ebec. No ordinary C function boundary can reproduce a mid-function branch target with a live caller-established register file; candidate-show confirms this directly (class=missing-extra-code, topology=uncovered:reference-indirect-dispatch-0x3a6, matched_prefix=0) since the compiler always inserts a prologue/parameter move sequence the reference does not have.
